name: deepai-code-gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible reverse-proxy gateway for the DeepAI Code managed model lane

scripts.test:allmodels: node --test tests/allmodels-pool.test.mjs tests/allmodels-concurrency.test.mjs tests/allmodels-mcp.test.mjs && node tests/allmodels-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:moonai: node --test tests/moonai-pool.test.mjs tests/moonai-fork-surface.test.mjs tests/moonai-svelte-build.test.mjs && node tests/moonai-e2e.mjs && node tests/moonai-admin.test.mjs && node tests/moonai-worker-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:providers: node --test tests/providers-wavespeed-novita.test.mjs tests/novita-pool.test.mjs && python tools/wavespeed-reg/tests/test_offline.py && python tools/novita-reg/tests/test_offline.py
scripts.test:blackbox: node --test tests/blackbox-provider.test.mjs && python -m unittest discover -s tools/blackbox-reg/tests && node tests/blackbox-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:loop: node scripts/check-loop.mjs && node --test tests/cleverai-pool.test.mjs tests/cleverai-routes.test.mjs tests/gabai-routes.test.mjs tests/proxyscrape-pool.test.mjs tests/proxyscrape-routes.test.mjs tests/proxy-export.test.mjs tests/jevai-pool.test.mjs tests/jevai-routes.test.mjs tests/line-candidates.test.mjs tests/openai-lines.test.mjs tests/lines-routes.test.mjs tests/captcha.test.mjs tests/verify-lines.test.mjs tests/pending-config.test.mjs tests/amd-routes.test.mjs tests/amd-study.test.mjs tests/amd-exam.test.mjs tests/amd-vouchers.test.mjs
scripts.test:workers: python -m pytest tools/linekit/tests tools/cleverai-reg/tests tools/gabai-reg/tests tools/zo-reg/tests tools/allmodels-reg/tests tools/novita-reg/tests tools/wavespeed-reg/tests tools/blackbox-reg/tests tools/poe-reg/tests tools/deepai-reg/tests tools/moonai-reg/tests tools/proxyscrape-reg/tests tools/jevai-reg/tests tools/agnes-reg/tests tools/cerebras-reg/tests tools/opencode-zen-reg/tests tools/requesty-reg/tests tools/unorouter-reg/tests tools/pollinations-reg/tests tools/giteeai-reg/tests tools/amd-reg/tests --import-mode=importlib -q
scripts.test:all: npm run loop && npm run test:loop && npm run test:fork && npm run test:workers && node tests/e2e.mjs && npm run test:providers
scripts.test:proxyscrape: node --test tests/proxyscrape-pool.test.mjs tests/proxyscrape-routes.test.mjs tests/proxy-export.test.mjs && python -m pytest tools/proxyscrape-reg/tests -q
scripts.test:jevai: node --test tests/jevai-pool.test.mjs tests/jevai-routes.test.mjs && python -m pytest tools/jevai-reg/tests -q
